title: Thai Toast with Zesty Cheese
description: A simple and flavorful Thai-inspired toast dish with zesty cheese and crunchy texture.

ingredients.name: zesty cheese
ingredients.notes: such as pepper jack or cheddar

instructions: 2. Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet.
3. Broil for 2-3 minutes or until lightly toasted and crispy.
4. Meanwhile, slice the zesty cheese into 1/4-inch thick slices.
5. Remove bread from the oven and top each slice with a slice of cheese.
6. Return to the broiler and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
7. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and green onions, if desired.
8. Serve immediately with Thai chili sauce.
